authority: RESEARCH FOUNDATION ONLY. Canonical time/session contract for all Stage 1 research artifacts. Supersedes Eastern-oriented terminology for the application/research/cohort/display layer. Changes NO production session behavior.
canonical_storage_role: immutable storage, joining, ordering, causal timestamp authority (ts_utc float epoch seconds)
canonical_application_role: application, operator, research-report, cohort-label, and display timezone (CST/CDT resolved via zoneinfo; no fixed offset)

exchange_calendar_authority.convention_note: the calendar stores the exchange convention in Eastern Time (open_et 09:30 / close_et 16:00, early_close 13:00 ET). ET appears ONLY here as the external exchange convention and is converted to UTC via America/New_York; it is never the application contract.

rth_label_ct: 08:30-15:00 Central Time (equivalent UTC instants to the exchange's 09:30-16:00 ET; half-days close 12:00 CT / 13:00 ET)
dst_policy: resolved via zoneinfo America/Chicago; NO manual/fixed offset; validated across CST, CDT, spring-forward and fall-back
holiday_policy: full_closures list in the exchange calendar -> session=closed all day
half_day_policy: early_closes list -> RTH close moves to the early-close time (13:00 ET / 12:00 CT)
session_crossover_policy: cohorts must not silently pool rth with premarket/afterhours/overnight; a bar's session is derived from ts_utc via America/Chicago + the exchange calendar, NEVER from a stored et_hour/et_minute/market_session column
unresolved_production_migration_items: production surfaces still classify/label in ET and, at db.py:4417-4420 + audit_model_readiness.py:31-32, filter RTH on DST-skewed stored et_hour/et_minute (RTH-integrity contradiction) — production migration to the CT+calendar authority is a SEPARATELY AUTHORIZED mission, not this one
math_volatility.session_bucket time-of-day feature is stored-clock and out-of-session-mislabeling
no production consumer reads the exchange calendar for cohort selection yet
the committed calendar is valid_through 2026-12-31 only; a renewal/authority process is required for institutional use

helper_sufficiency.time_et.is_rth_ts_utc: UTC-input, DST-aware ET boundary check; correct for RTH membership but has NO holiday/half-day awareness -> INSUFFICIENT as institutional cohort authority on its own
helper_sufficiency.ct_session.classify_session: calendar + DST aware (holidays + half-days); sufficient for Stage 1 research cohorts within the calendar's validity window
